questions.prompt: What happens when a function executes return value?
options: All variables in the module are cleared.
The function finishes and provides that value to its caller.
The value is printed automatically in every environment.

questions.explanation: A return value can be reused and tested independently of console output.

questions.prompt: After a fetch() call returns a Response, what should application code check?
options: Whether the browser has a localStorage entry.
response.ok or response.status before treating the response as successful.
questions.explanation: An HTTP 404/500 response is still a fulfilled fetch Promise; inspect the status before parsing it as successful data.
